business_summary: Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, invests in, constructs, develops, operates, and manages expressways and bridges in the People's Republic of China. The company was formerly known as GZI Transport Limited and changed its name to Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited in May 2011. Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited는 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국의 고속도로와 교량에 투자, 건설, 개발, 운영 및 관리합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 GZI Transport Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2011년 5월에 Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Yuexiu Transport Infrastructure Limited는 1996년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
